newsitem.title: THAILAND: NAP agrees to form six-party Thai coalition.
newsitem.headline: NAP agrees to form six-party Thai coalition.

text.p: Thailand's New Aspiration Party (NAP) said on Monday that it had agreed to form a six-party coalition that would be the basis of the next government.

"We agreed to form a six-party coalition that would include the NAP, Chart Pattana, Social Action Party, Prachakorn Thai, Seritham and Muanchon parties," said NAP leader Chavalit Yongchaiyudh after a meeting on the formation of the coalition.
The parties had signed a pact to jointly nominate Chavalit for the prime ministership, the NAP leader said in the presence of the leaders of the coalition partners.
The six coalition partners would have a comfortable majority of 221 seats in the 393-seat parliament.
The coalition will not include the Chart Thai party led by outgoing prime minster Banharn Silpa-archa which has 39 seats.
The NAP won Sunday's parliamentary election narrowly, taking 125 seats against 123 for its archrival, the Democrat Party of former prime minister Chuan Leekpai.
